prompts.name: 极简哑光
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE 16:9 widescreen frame from a coordinated eight-look CLEAN 3D visual development collection for a Chinese AI brand film. Same action and layout in every style, change only the requested visual treatment. No typography in the image; labels will be added outside.
Reference images define IDENTITY ONLY, not render texture: image 1 Chacha; image 2 Chamei. Both characters should be recognizable and fully modeled in 3D, NOT flat copies of the reference sheets.
Identity lock: Chacha LEFT is the white broad rounded-face squat mascot with tiny rounded ears, small black round eyes, small black nose and mouth, mint-green T-shirt, large white tail with exactly two black elongated marks. NO whiskers, no realistic animal muzzle, no generic cat face. Chamei RIGHT has the orange bear-ear hood with the hood's tiny bear eyes and nose, brown fringe and side locks, warm pale stylized face, small black oval eyes, small BLACK nose, restrained pink cheek circles, small rounded hands. No new pale muzzle patch on hood. No real-human anatomy or skin pores. Show both waist-up. Preserve basic head/body proportions and height relationship, avoid infant exaggeration.
Fixed composition/action: eye-level 50mm camera, medium-wide two-shot, characters each about one-third of the frame width, generous uncluttered upper-quarter negative space. One thin simple tabletop across lower quarter. Chacha and Chamei exchange ONE mint rounded rectangular card at frame center; both hands touch opposite ends of the card, both look at the exchange, slight friendly knowing smiles, no exaggerated open-mouth baby joy. Card shows one small simple WHITE picture/mountain icon. Character faces, card and hands all sharp; no portrait blur over crucial details. Minimal background described by the chosen style.
Keep exactly TWO characters, ONE table, ONE card. NO extra props, plants, furniture, machinery, cables, computers, floating graphics, decorative trinkets, mock UI, writing, logos, labels, watermarks or collage. No plush, fur, felt, coarse fabric weave, scratches, grunge, paper texture, brush strokes or film grain. Clean controlled surfaces, readable geometry and contact shadows.
Brand palette invariants: white mascot, mint shirt/card, orange hood, brown hair, warm-pale face, black small facial features. Background may use only white/gray/cream/mint/deep-green as specified. Realistic eye/nose highlights restrained; preserve simple facial design.
Style direction 01 (Matte baseline): Smooth matte animation shaders with extremely subtle broad reflections. Entire scene on a pale warm-gray seamless cyclorama, off-white satin tabletop. One broad softbox key upper-left and balanced neutral fill, soft grounding shadows, moderate contrast, no scenery. Relaxed refined brand animation, clean rounded modeled volumes, no plastic glare. Very calm white/mint/orange graphic balance.
